title: Inbox tab on the shared page layout: it spans the panel with the title row on top and the filter under the lead, no centred card, at every width; Mark all as read still works
steps: S1: Open the Inbox tab at 390, 430, 600, 900 and 1440 px wide.
S2: Read where the title row, the lead, the filter group and the lists sit.
S3: Press Mark all as read.
expect: S1: the Inbox spans the panel width; there is no centred card.
S2: the title row is on top, the filter group sits under the lead, the lists follow.
S3: the unread count clears and the button rests disabled.

selectors.tool: Playwright e2e of the Inbox page in a harness (test/e2e/inbox-fits-panel.test.mjs)

evidence: Before the change the Inbox drew its content in a centred card, unlike the other tabs; the owner reviewed the new layout on the local stand
fence: The real Inbox client in a Playwright harness page with stubbed data; the dsh host page around it is not loaded

tests: the Inbox spans the panel at 390px, title row on top, filter under the lead
the Inbox spans the panel at 1440px, title row on top, filter under the lead
Mark all as read still clears the count and then rests disabled
